newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's foreign reserves fall to $15.289 bln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's foreign reserves fall to $15.289 bln.

text.p: Venezuela's foreign reserves fell $260 million, or 1.7 percent, to $15.289 billion in the week to March 17, according to figures released by the Central Bank Monday.
Reserves were down from $15.549 billion on March 10, the bank's latest weekly bulletin of indicators showed.
Since the start of the year, reserve levels have risen $110 million, or 0.7 percent.
Reserves rose $5.5 billion, or 57 percent, last year to $15.179 billion and government officials have forecast they will grow to $20 billion by the end of 1997.
